z-m-25-12.title: Ma equation ecubic mangani ane midzi yose mitatu ma integer?
z-m-25-12.topic: Midzi ye integer yema equation ecubic: kuwana ma coefficient ose anogoneka
z-m-25-12.goal: Pasi pemamiriro ekuti midzi yose mitatu ma integer, wana ma triple akawanda emidzi anogoneka, uye utsanangure kuti nei ma equation anogoneka ari mashoma anogona kuverengwa.
z-m-25-12.material: Kuma integer a ne b, pane equation yecubic x³+ax²+bx−6=0 (x cubed plus a x squared plus b x minus 6 equals 0). Tinotsvaga nyaya umo midzi yose mitatu ye equation iyi ma integer. Midzi inodzokororwa inobvumirwawo.
z-m-25-12.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti nei nhamba dzenyaya dzakaverengeka
z-m-25-12.prereq.1: Unoziva hukama pakati pemidzi mitatu nema coefficient e equation yecubic (hukama pakati pemidzi nema coefficient).
z-m-25-12.s.s1.prompt: Kana midzi yose mitatu ma integer, sarudza nhamba isingagone kuva imwe yemidzi.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.hint.0: Isa mudzi we integer r mu equation, unganidza chinhu chisingachinji 6 kudivi rimwe, uye utarise kana unogona kuburitsa r sefactor.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.hint.1: Wana chigadzirwa chemidzi mitatu uye uongorore kuti chinobatana sei ne6.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.a: Kana −6 imudzi, ipapo −216+36a−6b−6=0, saka zvinogoneka ne b=6a−37. Zvigovanisi zvechinhu chisingachinji 6 zvinogona kuva midzi.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.b: 2 chigovanisi che6 uye inogona kuva mudzi. Semuenzaniso, pane nyaya umo midzi i1, 2, 3.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.c: Ichi chisarudzo chakaitwa nekufunga kuti kukosha kunofanira kuva nehukama hupi nechinhu chisingachinji kana mudzi uri integer.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.r.d: −1 chigovanisi che6 uye inogona kuva mudzi. Pane nyaya umo midzi i−1, −2, 3.
z-m-25-12.s.s1.explain: Kana pane mudzi we integer r, ipapo r³+ar²+br=6, ndiko kuti r(r²+ar+b)=6, saka r inofanira kuva chigovanisi che6. 4 haisi chigovanisi che6, saka haigoni kuva mudzi.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.prompt: Nyora midzi mitatu nenzira kubva pachidiki r1≤r2≤r3, wana (r1, r2, r3) 4 dzakasiyana umo midzi yose mitatu ma integer uye midzi ye x³+ax²+bx−6=0.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.hint.0: Wana seti dzose dzema integer matatu ane chigadzirwa 6, uchipatsanura kuita nyaya umo ose akanaka nenyaya umo nhamba mbiri dzakaipa dzakasanganiswa.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.hint.1: Kune musanganiswa wega wega waunowana, verenga chigadzirwa chemidzi mitatu uye uongorore kuti i6.

z-m-25-12.s.s2.ok.c3: Chigadzirwa chemidzi mitatu i6, iyo inoenderana nechinhu chisingachinji −6.
z-m-25-12.s.s2.fail.c3: Chinhu chisingachinji cheexpression yakagadzirwa kubva pamidzi mitatu hachisi −6.

z-m-25-12.s.s3.prompt: Pane (a, b) dzisingaperi kana dzakaverengeka dzinogutsa mamiriro aya here? Nyora kutonga kwako nechikonzero.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.hint.0: Kubva pamamiriro ekuti chigadzirwa chemidzi mitatu i6, funga kuti mudzi mumwe unogona kukura sei.
z-m-25-12.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora nyaya dzose dzawakawana uye uverenge.

z-m-25-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kuti kuchinjana kurongwa kwemidzi mitatu kunoverengwa senyaya imwe chete?
z-m-25-12.s.s3.model.0: Dzakaverengeka. Chigadzirwa chemidzi mitatu chakagadziriswa pa6, uye musanganiswa wema integer matatu ane chigadzirwa 6 wakaganhurirwa, saka (a, b) dzinobudawo chete nguva idzodzo.
